evaluation_policy: All criteria are hard pass/fail checks. A single failed criterion causes overall rejection.

criteria.name: Accuracy and Grounding
criteria.description: The lesson must explain RAG accurately and must not contain major factual errors.
criteria.pass_condition: All factual claims about RAG are consistent with the trusted reference.

criteria.name: Beginner Friendly Language
criteria.description: The lesson must be understandable to a learner with no prior AI background.
criteria.pass_condition: Uses simple English, short explanations, and introduces concepts from zero.

criteria.name: Key Concept Coverage
criteria.description: The lesson must cover the fundamental ideas required to understand RAG.
criteria.pass_condition: Explains what RAG is, why it matters, retrieval, context, generation, workflow, example, and limitations.

criteria.name: Jargon Control
criteria.description: Technical terminology must not be used without explanation.
criteria.pass_condition: Important technical terms are explained in simple language before or when they are introduced.

criteria.name: Learning by Example
criteria.description: The lesson must teach the concept using a concrete beginner-friendly example.
criteria.pass_condition: Contains at least one realistic example that connects RAG to a familiar situation.

criteria.name: Teaching Flow
criteria.description: The lesson must follow a logical teaching sequence.
criteria.pass_condition: Moves logically from the problem to the concept, process, example, limitations, and summary.
